verdict.line: You lose if you eat Riven's level 3-5 Q-W stun combo standing still; you win from level 6 on once Hextech Ultimatum can anchor her before she Valors out.

brief.thesis: This matchup sits at 50.8% over 575 games because both champions' engage tools are conditional rather than free: Camille's Hookshot (E) only knocks up on landing when she leaps off a nearby wall, while Riven's Valor (E, cooldown 10/9/8/7/6s) lets her block incoming damage and reposition on a short timer. Riven's spike comes first — by level 3 she has all three reactivations of Broken Wings (Q, cooldown 13s) plus the stun on Ki Burst (W, cooldown 11/10/9/8/7s) — while Camille's answer, The Hextech Ultimatum (R), which dashes to and anchors her target, doesn't come online until level 6. Whoever tracks the other's cooldowns and terrain better wins the lane, not raw stats.

theirWindow.what: Riven can chain Broken Wings (Q) into Ki Burst (W) and use Valor (E) to block your return damage or reposition mid-combo. Don't extend a trade until you've seen her use E.

yourWindow.what: With Valor down she has no damage-block or dash. Walk up, land an auto to trigger Adaptive Defenses (passive shield), and if she tries to flee use The Hextech Ultimatum (R) to anchor her before she can Wind Slash away with Blade of the Exile.

start.why: Run in 73.8% of games at 51.1% WR (503 games) — the extra AD lets you punish Riven whenever Valor (E) is down instead of only farming safely.

boots.why: 84.1% pick, 54% WR over 504 games — Riven's Runic Blade passive dumps its damage through basic attacks, and Steelcaps directly cuts that down.

core.why: First item in the 55% WR core path (160 games) — the move speed and damage proc help you stick through a Valor (E) dash.
Sustains you through extended trades and speeds up wave clear so you can hold freezes near your own tower.
Closes out the highest-winrate core path (55%, 48.1% pick) — bleeds damage over time so Riven's burst combo doesn't delete you outright.

runes.keystoneWhy: Higher-winrate page here (53.6% over the 26.3%-pick sample) — Grasp rewards you for landing an auto during every trade window and pads health, which matters against Riven's short-cooldown poke.

summoners.why: Highest winrate and pick rate combo (54% WR, 68.2% pick). Ignite punishes any healing item Riven buys and secures kills once your E knockup or R anchor locks her down; Flash covers the gap when you don't have a wall for Hookshot.

playing.title: Don't stand still at level 3
playing.detail: The moment Riven hits 3 she has all three reactivations of Broken Wings (Q) and the stun on Ki Burst (W) available together. Hold position on the edge of her W range until you've baited one of them out.

playing.title: Auto before you trade
playing.detail: Land a basic attack to trigger Adaptive Defenses (passive) before Riven's stun lands — the shield absorbs the physical damage type she deals.

playing.title: Track Valor, not just her HP
playing.detail: Valor (E, cooldown 10/9/8/7/6s) is both her damage block and her escape. If you see her use it, you have a clean window to punish before it's back.

playing.title: Only Hookshot off a wall
playing.detail: E only knocks up on landing when Camille leaps off a wall — used away from terrain it's just a repositioning tool, not an engage.

playing.title: Save R for her dash
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors Riven in place once you land it, denying her the Wind Slash from Blade of the Exile and any Valor-based disengage. Don't burn it as a pure damage tool before level 6 combat starts.

playing.title: Land the outer edge of W
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep's outer half slows and deals extra damage while healing you — aim for that band after she closes in, not the inner hit.

playing.title: Itemize against her burst, not her sustain
playing.detail: Riven's threat is a single combo, not prolonged damage — Sterak's Gage or Death's Dance blunts that far more than raw health stacking.

brief.patchCaveat: All items, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1) — the timing and mechanical reasoning tying them together is our own read of the matchup, not pulled from data.

stats.opponentTip: Riven is strong when she reaches level 3 and level 6! Use your passive [P] to absorb as much damage when engaging! Rather than initiating combat yourself, try to respond to when Riven closes in!
